notes.title: Online Leaderboards
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26474471/f211176427afdcc3fb8d50467333c5b4ab750e98.png[/img]

The Party Golf single-player experience has just gotten a little more social with the addition of ONLINE LEADERBOARDS!

Dust off the 9-iron and practice your Party Golf skills by completing as many holes as possible. Compete with your friends, or with players around the world, including the Party Golf developers (Giant Margarita) who will stop at nothing to remain top of our own leaderboards.

Checked out Trials mode yet? Your existing best scores will automatically go into the leaderboards when you launch the game, and you'll see a few extra additions that help you compare your run to your Personal Bests while you play.

For those new to trials, Party Golf has over 100 different trials where you play hand-picked levels, and attempt to complete as many holes as you can within a certain Shot, Time, or Distance Limit. 
Some trials you play as a Banana, others you play with the Spiderball powerup. There are super speed trials and slow motion trials - overall Party Golf has 14 different trials categories and we plan to add even more in the future! Some are short, some are marathon level - just like standard Party Golf game, there is a wealth of variation. 

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bVU7Jqdd-wI]Here is an example of one of the devs doing a  run of a checkpoints trial[/url].

There's also a whole heap of stability improvements and fixes that have been applied in this update too. Remember if you find a bug we're always checking the community forums and happy to work through any issues you find.

*Trials mode can still be played with multiple players

notes.title: Party Golf Release
notes.content:
Giant Margarita here!

Party Golf has been set for a October 26th (6pm US PDT) release date on Steam. 

The game has been updated for delicious 4K resolutions, and also has full keyboard and mouse support if that's your jam ;0

See you on the green on the 26th of October!

notes.title: Party Golf Release Date
notes.content:
We've locked down our Steam release date, and we're happy to announce that Party Golf will be available in Late October 2016! Whilst we have no exact date set, we're hoping for around the 25th of October.

We're also super active on [url=https://www.facebook.com/giantmargarita]Facebook[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/giantmargarita]Twitter[/url], so come and say hi!

See you all on the green in Late October ;)
